players.product: BlueBird Block 2 direct-to-cell satellites (custom AST5000 ASIC) and MNO gateway equipment

quarterly_data.signal: AST 10-Q: BB8, BB9 and BB10 were launched on June 17, 2026 and deployed in July 2026, and BB11, BB12 and BB13 were launched on August 5, 2026. The total loss on BB7, net of $32.5 million of insurance recoveries, was approximately $125.9 million, and AST expects a replacement launch under the applicable contract with the launch provider. AST has completed fully assembled microns for up to 36 BB satellites, and supplier agreements and orders are in place for a large majority of the planned constellation of over 90 BB satellites.
quarterly_data.figure: BB7 net loss approximately $125.9 million; insurance $32.5 million; microns for 36 satellites

quarterly_data.signal: AST 10-Q: Q2 2026 products revenue was $24.4 million from gateway equipment and related software sold to MNOs (including related-party sales to SatCo of $1.9 million in the quarter and $9.8 million in the six months) and services revenue $7.1 million from U.S. government agreements; remaining performance obligations approximately $1.2 billion (approximately 6.6% expected within 12 months); contract liabilities $266.9 million, the increase mainly from an advance payment under a commercial service agreement; purchase commitments approximately $775.0 - $795.0 million for components, R&D, gateway equipment and other projects.
quarterly_data.figure: products $24.4 million; services $7.1 million; RPO approximately $1.2 billion (6.6% within 12 months); commitments $775.0 - $795.0 million

quarterly_data.signal: AST 10-Q: AST received certain regulatory approvals for its SpaceMobile Service on April 22, 2026, and the $45.0 million Verizon commercial prepayment is now due; AST made the $100.0 million Ligado payment for the benefit of Inmarsat on or about March 31, 2026, but a Bankruptcy Court order of April 2, 2026 placed it in escrow; on March 2, 2026 the Third Circuit vacated the District Court's stay of the order requiring Inmarsat's regulatory support, and Inmarsat withdrew its FCC filing opposing Ligado's application, while Inmarsat's appeal remains pending.
quarterly_data.figure: Verizon $45.0 million due; $100.0 million in escrow
